snippet.title: Lord of Ogre - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
- Wishlist on Steam  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464490

Lord of Ogre is a turn-based game that combines action elements with combat mechanics such as combo attacks and blocking enemy strikes. It also incorporates RPG basics, allowing players to equip weapons, rings, and customize their skills for battle. In the game world, you’ll need to strategically plan the movement of various units on the map.

Music Composer : Yoshiki Ara
Fantasy RPG Music /Asgard Aube Season 1 Ancient Dragon

- X (Twitter)  https://x.com/Bluejoy_Stick
- Website  https://www.lordofogre.com/
